summary: Execution is allowed. Final generator.py and model_spec.json are byte-identical to initial, and identical invented inputs/seeds produce identical outputs. The revision adds correctly extracted evidence, source-context qualifications and numerical diagnostics, with a justified exact model no-op; it does not improve generated data numerically or establish target accuracy. New Taiwan age contrasts and Turkish obesity-class means/SDs agree with approved sources; variance and plug-in source calculations reproduce. Initial/final candidate commitments, prior review, approved artifact links and completed gap/action records pass. No blocking implementation, extraction or protocol issue was found. Static checking is not a sandbox.

change_classification.classification: justified exact no-op of generator and specification; evidence extraction and qualification changes
change_classification.interpretation: Retrieval and diagnostic work substantiates the recorded choice and exposes unresolved uncertainty. It is separate from numerical data improvement.

initial_findings_response.response: Addressed by re-extraction of all Taiwan Table 5 age contrasts/p-values and Table 2 age-by-BMI counts, direct comparison with pooled contrasts, and an explicit retention decision. Scientific age heterogeneity remains unresolved.

Addressed by correct explicit age-mixture variance accounting and continued separation of source cell SD from assumed conditional residual SD. No unsupported variance deduction or joint distribution was introduced; source operator remains unidentified.

Addressed by focused retrieval of two approved primary reports, documented inaccessible/rejected leads, Turkish obesity-class contrast and plug-in checks, and a reasoned retention of the existing high-BMI assumptions. Exact source/target calibration remains unsupported.

findings.evidence_location: final/evidence.json E_TW_AGE_BY_BMI and E_DALLAS_AGE; final/decision.md age retention; final/artificial_checks.json revision_checks.age_modifier_sensitivity.
findings.issue: The correctly re-extracted BMI-stratified age estimates differ from the retained pooled age pattern. Richer adjustment, uncertain interactions and missing sex-specific source structure prevent a uniquely justified replacement, so the exact no-op is acceptable for execution but does not resolve age applicability. The final record states this openly.
findings.suggested_action: Carry this unresolved limitation into interpretation of age and subgroup analyses. No further optimization or pre-execution code repair is requested.

findings.issue: The added 0.2107827354 (mg/dL)^2 between-age variance calculation is correct under the declared midpoint mixture. It remains a constructed diagnostic; the unavailable source within-cell distributions, conditional residual spread, lognormal tail family and population/assay transport remain assumptions. Correct computation and clearer qualification do not validate those components.
findings.suggested_action: Retain the distinction between chosen conditional moments, observed aggregate constraints and target validation when reporting the pilot. No unsupported residual subtraction or new source calibration is needed before execution.

findings.evidence_location: final/evidence.json E_TUR_OBESITY_CLASSES/E_MEX_OBESITY_LEAD; approved Turkish Table 1 and Methods; final/artificial_checks.json revision_checks.turkish_obesity_contrast; final/model_spec.json A_TAIL.
findings.issue: The Turkish class-III minus class-I contrast is correctly -5.24 mg/dL, and its selected-sex plug-in comparisons reproduce. Small selected groups, missing class-specific sex mix and joint predictors, and nonlinear averaging prevent treating these comparisons as an exact source fit. They leave the retained asymptotes/decay and severe-obesity target behavior unidentified. The final candidate correctly qualifies this and retains the flat alternative.
findings.suggested_action: Treat the new source as contextual support for a plausible scenario, with the recorded limits. Do not describe the retained tail as newly calibrated or the sensitivity pair as a confidence interval; no pre-execution repair is requested.

tests: Verified all 14 initial and 21 final candidate freeze commitments, prior review commitments, and both gateway audit-prefix snapshots without reading run_commitment participant inputs.

Verified exact initial/final generator and specification SHA-256 equality and generator_or_spec_changed=false. All initial source and evidence records remain unchanged; the final ledger adds two sources and three evidence items.

Validated final evidence/spec/gap/action schemas and references; all final gaps have non-open explicit dispositions and linked revision actions. Verified all 45 source/action artifact links against actual SHA-256 values and accepted own-session audit registry events.

Checked literature usage of eight queries/seven download attempts, two excluded_study_alias rejections in the audit, and the Mexican unsupported PDF supplement status. No rejected article content or external retrieval was used.
Independently compared all 12 nonreference Taiwan age contrasts and p-values, all 16 age-by-BMI counts and four stratum totals against approved XML. Extracted values agree.

Independently compared Turkish class I/II/III mean and SD for age, BMI and HDL against approved XML; confirmed Table 1 says mean plus/minus SD, group counts 10/13/22 in Methods, exclusions and unpaired group context, and p-values against normal weight. Reviewed Mexican sample restrictions, 12-hour fasting COBAS c111 measurement and inaccessible table context in approved maintext.
Read frozen generator and ran loop_control.source_check before importing both versions. Static AST review passed; this is not a sandbox.

Executed final and initial on the same 70 invented rows across both sexes, BMI 13 to 81 and ages 20 to 79, with nonstandard index, at seeds 176 and 355. Outputs match exactly between versions; same-seed reproducibility, different-seed variability, exact input preservation/order/schema, finite positive output, no input/spec/global NumPy RNG mutation passed.

Recomputed all recorded stratified-minus-pooled age contrasts, age-mixture variance 0.2107827353998677, and eight marginal SD diagnostics. Recomputed Turkish -5.24 mg/dL class contrast and both selected-sex/flat-tail plug-in comparisons within 1e-12.
Detailed reviewer checks and executable invented-input script saved outside frozen candidate in final_review_checks.json and final_review_checks.py. No frozen file was edited.
review_scope: Own approved evidence and artificial inputs only; no real outcomes, observed rows, other runs or new retrieval
